# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.9

- The IDE filesystem-watcher tests continue to check real atomic replacements when Windows briefly holds a fixture file open.
- The desktop drag-preparation test sets a fixed modification time on its generated rclone folder after creating its contents. The real download and revision checks still run.
- This source prerelease carries forward alpha.8’s application code and dependency pins and runs fresh desktop, native mobile, and embedded runtime checks.
